title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.15303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time compute can substantially improve Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning performance, yet how and when additional compute helps remains poorly understood. We study Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR), a simple two-phase primitive consisting of an exploration phase that generates multiple candidate solutions followed by a convergent reconciliation phase. We present three core results. First, we show that even a single reconciliation step can reliably amplify correct minority reports: across datasets, DCR often recovers the correct answer when correct exploration outputs are in the minority, a regime where majority voting fails. Second, we introduce recursive DCR, an autoregressive reconciliation system that iteratively analyzes disagreements and allocates additional test-time compute. Recursive DCR achieves higher accuracy than fixed-compute baselines-reaching 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025-while using roughly 27% less

translated_title: 发散-收敛推理：通过结构化解决方案合成扩展测试时计算
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15303v1 公告类型：新 摘要：测试时计算可以显著提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理性能，但额外计算如何以及何时发挥作用仍未被充分理解。我们研究了发散-收敛推理（DCR），这是一种简单的两阶段原语，包括生成多个候选解决方案的探索阶段和随后的收敛调和阶段。我们提出了三个核心结果。首先，我们表明即使单次调和步骤也能可靠地放大正确的少数派报告：在多个数据集上，当正确的探索输出处于少数派时，DCR通常能恢复正确答案，而多数投票在这种情况下会失败。其次，我们引入了递归DCR，一种自回归调和系统，它迭代地分析分歧并分配额外的测试时计算。递归DCR在固定计算基线上实现了更高的准确率——在AIME 2024上达到93.3%，在AIME 2025上达到92.0%——同时使用的计算量减少了约27%。
tldr: 本文提出发散-收敛推理（DCR）方法，通过探索生成多样候选方案并递归调和分歧，在少数派正确场景下显著提升推理准确率，且比固定计算基线节省约27%的计算资源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR), which generates diverse candidate solutions during exploration and recursively reconciles disagreements, significantly boosting reasoning accuracy in minority-correct scenarios while using about 27% less compute than fixed-compute baselines.
